items: Eluta's result pages now show a real snippet directly in search results (a change from prior runs) and, for most postings, an inline "Show more" expansion that reveals the full posting without needing the cache-link workaround — used successfully for Braze and Kinaxis. It did not work reliably for every posting (theScore), consistent with prior runs' documented unreliability; scored from the listing summary in that case per established practice in this repo's history.

Ran DevOps Engineer, Senior DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, and Infrastructure Engineer as remote-filtered passes, plus one Ottawa city pass (unfiltered by remote, since hybrid discovery intentionally doesn't use the remote filter). Stopped there given the scope already covered today across 8 other boards — the remaining 4 remote keywords and 4 city passes (Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal) are a reasonable next-run target, not run this time.

"Cloud Engineer" and "Infrastructure Engineer" are both extremely broad terms on this site (695 and 728 total results respectively) — only the first page of each was reviewed, consistent with the skill's 10-result-per-query boundary.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.

method: October 7, 2026: 26 of 26 Eluta passes completed (one human-verification pause cleared by the user); 157 cache IDs; 31 postings read in full; 23 empty shells unvalidated; 0 filed. 2026-09-22 continuation run: closed out the 4 remote-keyword passes and 4 city passes left incomplete by 2026-09-21's run, plus a spot re-check of the DevOps Engineer keyword (unchanged). 9 passes attempted, 8 complete (zero-result Kingston/Brockville counted as complete), 1 posting (Degree Inc.) could not be validated after both the inline-expansion and cache-link methods failed. 8 new candidate postings reviewed in full; 2 filed to applications.md (McKesson score 7, Genetec score 5) per the automatic-filing policy — both new employers, no existing applications.md row. 2 hard-gated below the filing bar on cost/cadence (SAP BTP 3d/wk onsite at moderate pay, Tecsys AWS-centric ambiguous cadence), 1 AWS hard-gate (Baby List), 1 geographic ineligibility (HostPapa/managed.com excludes Ontario residents), 1 out-of-scope (Xplore telecom RF management). All 18 pipeline matches from 2026-09-21 remain unchanged and were not re-verified this run.
